# Organic Computer — Full Reference

> organiccomputer.me — the human mind, spec'd like hardware, and benchmarked
> against the supercomputer you'd otherwise have to buy. A project of the
> Intellectual Resistance, under IT Help San Diego Inc. This page is a
> datasheet, not a booking surface: professional consulting routes through
> https://book.squareup.com/appointments/mwhvoaiqecb5o2/location/LA35149CK62SV/services.

## What this is

The scarcest resource in business today is not information — it is a person who
will actually sit and think about a problem. Executives are overwhelmed; support
lines are automated; AI bolted onto everything answers fast, confident, and
often wrong. Organic Computer is the deliberate inverse told as a datasheet:
the human brain presented as a literal compute substrate, spec'd like hardware
and benchmarked against the machine you'd otherwise have to buy.

The point is universal, not personal: every human is an organic computer, with
an identical spec sheet. What varies is whether the module is operated
deliberately — the discipline is available to everyone, and it is the same
discipline that runs under every instrument in the family. AI exists because
this process works: silicon is human thinking, automated. The organic module is
where the judgment lives.

Every figure is sourced; the tone is scientific; the humor lives only in the
premise.

## The specifications (all sourced)

- Peak throughput: ~10^18 FLOPS (exaflop-equivalent at spiking-neural-network
  emulation level). Functional range ~9x10^15 – 3.4x10^17 FLOPS. Conservative
  bound < 1 PFLOPS. [Sandberg & Bostrom 2008; AI Impacts; Drexler 2019; NIST]
- Power envelope: ~20 W at rest — about a dim lightbulb. [NIST, 2023]
- Energy efficiency: ~5x10^16 FLOPS/J — roughly a million times better than the
  best silicon at exaflop scale. [derived from NIST + TOP500]
- Decision latency: ~100 ms perception-to-action. [NIST]
- Substrate: ~86 billion neurons, ~1.5x10^14 synapses; ~1.35 kg; ~1,260 cm^3;
  ~37 °C; self-fabricating, self-repairing. [NINDS; Herculano-Houzel 2009;
  Drachman 2005]
- Coolant: ~1 L of water per day (4–5 tall glasses). [Mayo Clinic]

## The hardware equivalence

To match the organic module's throughput you would buy a Frontier-class
supercomputer: ~1.35 EFLOPS, ~24.6 MW of power, ~2 tennis courts of floor space,
and a sticker price of about $600,000,000 (U.S. Department of Energy / Oak Ridge
National Laboratory; TOP500 Nov 2024, No. 2: 1.353 EFLOPS Rmax, ~24,600 kW). The
organic module runs on ~20 W and a glass of water —
and, unlike the silicon, it understands the problem.

## The discipline

Not a special brain — a deliberately-operated one. The spec sheet is identical
in every skull. The discipline that runs the module properly:

- Architecture: the stock module — identical hardware everywhere; what varies
  is whether it is aimed.
- Operating envelope: water, sleep, silence. Even mild dehydration measurably
  degrades vigilance and working memory (Ganio 2011). A rested, undistracted
  module is a spec, not a virtue.
- Input hygiene: from the source, in engineered quiet. Garbage priors produce
  garbage conclusions; go to primary evidence.
- Operating discipline: AI as instrument, never author. Machines cross-reference
  and stress-test; human logic drives.

The claim that a deliberately-operated module can hold one problem for hours is
anecdotal — not yet instrument-measured. The instrument to measure it is
Calibration Scope.

## The Verification Principle

The method is governed by Bayesian anti-dogmatism. A question's foundation is
the prior you start with. Core theorem: if P(E) > 0 and P(H) is exactly 0 or 1,
then P(H | E) = P(H) — a belief pinned at certain or impossible is unrevisable;
evidence bounces off. Honest reasoning sets empirical priors bounded away from 0
and 1 and updates in odds form (posterior odds = Bayes factor × prior odds). The
same engine scores findings on DNS Tool (https://dnstool.it-help.tech). It holds
for a DNS record, an argument between friends, or polarized politics — anywhere a
mind updates on evidence. Maxim: "The answer to a question lives in the
foundations of the question. To understand those foundations — that is logic."

## The Intellectual Resistance

Resistance, in a circuit, is what makes current usable. Thinking is the same —
friction, doubt, and the deliberate pause before the answer are not the
obstacle; they are the work. Organic Computer is a project of the Intellectual
Resistance (https://intellectualresistance.com), the larger body of work on
logic, reason, and thinking that shows its work.

earbuds, no hangover; water, sleep, silence; AI as instrument, never author.
